description: Discover cheap flight destinations from an origin via SerpAPI's Google Flights Deals engine (google_flights_deals). Unlike google_flights_search there is no arrival_id — the engine explores destinations for you — and there are no pagination or navigation tokens. Dates accept a single YYYY-MM-DD or a 'start,end' range (e.g. '2026-06-27,2026-07-03') to widen the window. Supports round trip (type=1, needs return_date) and one way (type=2). Prices are in `currency` (default USD). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_metadata, search_parameters, departure_informations, deals: [...] } — the list key is `deals` (there are no best_flights/other_flights here). Each deal: { destination_id, name, country, price, average_price, discount_percentage, flight_link, serpapi_flight_link, thumbnail, outbound_date, return_date, departure_airport_code, arrival_airport_code, flight_duration, stops, airline, airline_code, description, highlights }. The dates are `outbound_date` / `return_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) — the live engine returns those, not the `start_date`/`end_date` of SerpAPI's docs — and a deal carries NO departure or return time.

currency.description: Currency of returned prices (ISO code, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). Default USD.

departure_id.description: Departure AIRPORT IATA code(s) (3-letter, uppercase, e.g. 'WAW' or 'WAW,WMI') or a Google location kgmid (/m/… or /g/…). Comma-separate multiple. NOT a city/metro code (NYC, LON, PAR return no results — list the airports). No arrival_id: the deals engine discovers destinations for you.

exclude_airlines.description: Exclude these airlines: comma-separated 2-letter IATA codes, or an alliance (STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD). Mutually exclusive with include_airlines.

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

include_airlines.description: Only these airlines: comma-separated 2-letter IATA codes, or an alliance: STAR_ALLIANCE, SKYTEAM, ONEWORLD. Mutually exclusive with exclude_airlines.

infants_in_seat.description: Number of infants in seat. Default 0.

infants_on_lap.description: Number of infants on lap. Default 0.

max_duration.description: Maximum total trip duration in minutes (e.g. 1500 for 25h).

max_price.description: Maximum ticket price in the selected currency.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

outbound_date.description: Outbound date as a single YYYY-MM-DD, or a 'start,end' range (e.g. '2026-06-27,2026-07-03') to search a window.

return_date.description: Return date as a single YYYY-MM-DD, or a 'start,end' range. Required when type=1 (round trip). When outbound_date is a range it must be a 'start,end' range too (or drop it and use trip_length/travel_duration).

stops.description: Max stops: 0 = any (default), 1 = nonstop only, 2 = 1 stop or fewer, 3 = 2 stops or fewer.

travel_class.description: Travel class: 1 = economy (default), 2 = premium economy, 3 = business, 4 = first.

travel_duration.description: Travel duration preset: 1 = one week, 2 = weekend, 3 = two weeks.

trip_length.description: Trip length in days: a single number, or a 'min,max' day range (e.g. '3,5').

type.description: Trip type: 1 = round trip (default, needs return_date), 2 = one way.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_flights_deals_search
title: Search Google Flights Deals (SerpAPI)
